title: Shim: 4-Tier Capability Permission Gating, Ancestor Symlink Sandbox & Bounded File/Shell Execution
summary: Shim partitions every tool under four capability levels (read, write, shell, external) and gates Executor.Execute() across three permission modes: read-only rejects any level != read, ask prompts interactive y/yes verification for non-read tools, and auto permits execution without prompts while requiring strict JSON Schema additionalProperties=false. FileTools.secure() canonicalizes the workspace root and walks both targets and deepest existing ancestor directories with filepath.EvalSymlinks + within() containment to defeat symlink escapes, capping file reads at 2 MiB (2<<20), 2000 lines, and rejecting NUL-byte binaries, while shell execution caps buffered stdout+stderr at 1 MiB (1<<20) with a 2-minute timeout.

references.description: Level enum (Read/Write/Shell/External), mutex Registry, Executor permission modes, and Schema() with additionalProperties=false
FileTools.secure() ancestor EvalSymlinks + within() containment and 2 MiB / 2000-line / NUL-byte read guards
Shell timeout default (2m) and cappedBuffer 1 MiB (1<<20) output cap
